output.report_text: Creative Fatigue Report — Over the last 30 days, 8 ads were analyzed with no URGENT fatigue cases, 5 ads showing WARNING signs, and 3 ads performing HEALTHY. The account shows moderate fatigue overall, with several ads experiencing notable declines in performance metrics such as click-through rate (CTR) and engagement. While some ads maintain stable CPM trends, the drop in CTR and engagement signals a need to refresh creatives to sustain campaign effectiveness. Monitoring should continue on healthy ads to ensure they remain within optimal performance ranges. Top 3 to replace first: 1. Ad_137/02/1_Interest(mid&Highbrands)Catalog(October25-TopPerforming) is flagged due to a significant 39.69% CTR drop and 15.86% engagement decay over 227 days active. Frequency is moderately high at 1.64, and CPM is falling, indicating reduced audience interest. 2. Ad_031/28/79_MOF(Fb_Ig_7D)_MusicDay_Sale_Image1_June'26 - Copy shows a 33.88% CTR decline within just 3 days active. Frequency is lower at 1.22, with stable CPM and no engagement decay yet, suggesting early signs of fatigue primarily from CTR decay. 3. Ad_138/01/15_Broad_BAU_Energyshroom_PB310_Powerbank_Upto60%_OFF_V2_IMAGE has a 32.2% CTR drop and complete engagement decay (100%) after 195 days. Frequency is low at 1.14 and CPM stable, but the engagement loss is critical, signaling urgent need for creative refresh. Planning replacements for these ads is recommended to prevent further performance decline and maintain campaign momentum.
